headline: Names a Postal Service building in North Kingstown, Rhode Island, after Melvoid J. Benson.
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility at 7715 Post Road in North Kingstown, Rhode Island, as the Melvoid J. Benson Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, hours, or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on June 13, 2016.
